title: Boaz Redeems Ruth

questions.question: Where did Boaz go to settle the redemption?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:1 (ESV): “Now Boaz had gone up to the gate and sat down there...”

questions.question: What did the nearer redeemer refuse to redeem?
options: Ruth, to avoid marring his inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: Ruth, to avoid marring his inheritance
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:5–6 (ESV): “...‘On the day you buy the field... you are also buying Ruth...’ Then the redeemer said, ‘I cannot redeem it... lest I impair my own inheritance.’”

questions.question: What custom confirmed the redemption transfer?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:7–8 (ESV): “Now this was the custom in former times in Israel... a man removed his sandal and gave it to the other... So the redeemer removed his sandal.”

questions.question: What son was born to Ruth and Boaz?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:17 (ESV): “And the women of the neighborhood gave him a name, saying, ‘A son has been born to Naomi.’ They named him Obed.”

questions.question: Who was Obed’s grandson?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:21–22 (ESV): “Salmon fathered Boaz, Boaz fathered Obed, Obed fathered Jesse, and Jesse fathered David.”

questions.question: How many elders did Boaz gather?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:2 (ESV): "And he took ten men of the elders of the city and said, 'Sit down here.'"

questions.question: Who was the land belonging to?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:3 (ESV): "...the parcel of land that belonged to our relative Elimelech."

questions.question: What witnesses did Boaz call upon?
options: The elders and all the people at the gate
questions.correctAnswer: The elders and all the people at the gate
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:9 (ESV): "Then Boaz said to the elders and all the people, 'You are witnesses this day...'"

questions.question: What blessing did the people give concerning Ruth?
options: May the Lord make the woman... like Rachel and Leah
questions.correctAnswer: May the Lord make the woman... like Rachel and Leah
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:11 (ESV): "...May the LORD make the woman, who is coming into your house, like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel."

questions.question: What blessing did the women give Naomi regarding the child?
options: He shall be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:15 (ESV): "He shall be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age..."

questions.question: Why specifically did the redeemer decline when Ruth was mentioned?
options: Lest I impair my own inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: Lest I impair my own inheritance
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:6 (ESV): "...I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I impair my own inheritance..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Boaz?
Who was the father of Perez?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:12 (ESV): "...like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah..."

questions.question: What did Naomi do with the child?
options: Laid him on her lap and became his nurse
questions.correctAnswer: Laid him on her lap and became his nurse
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:16 (ESV): "Then Naomi took the child and laid him on her lap and became his nurse."

questions.question: The genealogy at the end of Ruth goes from Perez to whom?
questions.explanation: Ruth 4:18-22 (ESV): "Now this is the genealogy of Perez... and Jesse fathered David."

key_verse_text: And the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a redeemer, and may his name be renowned in Israel!” (ESV)
